# Synthetic validator fixtures

These are deterministic positive and negative controls. Even rows that set
fixture_only=false intentionally simulate an eligible receipt to test policy;
they do not document real reviewers, tools, searches, or scientific findings.
Combined-review expectations are supplied by the test author. Never copy them
into research bundles as evidence of completed work. Legacy fixtures preserve
unknown evidence; current fixtures exercise the 1.2.2 contract.
